title: SIU identifies man killed in west-end shooting
article: The province's police watchdog has identified a man who died after being shot during an altercation with Toronto police.
Frank Anthony Berry, 48, was pronounced dead at hospital following the incident Monday morning in the city's west end.
The Special Investigations Unit says police were investigating a man on Campbell Avenue.
Berry was shot during an "interaction" with police.
The SIU has assigned five investigators and three forensic investigators to probe the incident.
The agency investigates incidents involving police that result in injury or death.
